A requirement-id pattern written as SWS_Can_\d+ matches none of these three, and nothing else in the fixture set would notice — the manifest's per-document req_id_pattern carries the '(?:_CONSTR)?' group for exactly this reason. requirements.text: The ECUC partitions referenced by CanControllerEcucPartitionRef shall be a subset of the ECUC partitions referenced by CanEcucPartitionRef.
CanController and CanTrcvChannel of one communication channel shall all reference the same ECUC partition.
If CanEcucPartitionRef references one or more ECUC partitions, CanControllerEcucPartitionRef shall have a multiplicity of one and reference one of these ECUC partitions as well.
